thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx spike on inference-gateway (us-west-2) — 5xx rate 4.6% over last 5m (baseline 0.12%). Service: inference-gateway-prod. Latency tail and connection reset counts rising. Paging on-call.

alex: I’m on pager, jumping in. Can someone grab grafana and traces?

jess: looking at grafana, 5xx is concentrated on the lb->envoy hop. 502/504 and a lot of HTTP/2 GOAWAY/stream resets.

mike: added logs: from envoy: 
```
[2026-04-15T12:13:02Z] envoy upstream reset: "connection failure" cluster: inference-backend_pool
[2026-04-15T12:13:04Z] envoy upstream 502 Bad Gateway route: /v1/generate host: ib-prod-1
```

sarah: I can see a sudden retry amplification from the load balancer — retry attempts spiked ~x6 at same time. Circuit-breaker Ejects also increased for a subset of hosts.

kate: @jess which routes are affected? can we confirm route weighting change / rollout?

jess: affected routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Weighting shows envoys in shard-a got 90% of traffic due to a recent weight swap in the LB config at ~12:05 UTC.

alex: aha — weight swap + aggressive retry policy + low cb thresholds => retry amplification causing connection thrash and 502s. Need quick mitigation.

mike: suggested quick actions: 1) reduce LB retries to 1 for HTTP/2 2) revert weight to even distribution 3) raise cb thresholds temporarily to avoid ejects.

ops-bot: @channel runbook checkpoint: "Mitigate retry amplification" — owners: alex, jess. Steps: validate traffic distribution, change LB retry policy, throttle retries, monitor.

jess: running a dry-run with envoy config check. Command: `kubectl -n infra exec -it envoy-ingress-0 -- envoy --config-path /etc/envoy/envoy.yaml --mode validate`

mike: confirming LB control plane shows a weight delta patch deployed at 12:04 by infra-ci. rolling back to previous weights now.

alex: applying immediate LB patch to restore weights. `lbctl patch-service inference-gateway --set-route-weight shard-a=50,shard-b=50 --author alex`

sarah: rollback acknowledged by LB: weight restored at 12:16 UTC. Pre-rollback traffic: shard-a 90% shard-b 10%. Post-rollback: 50/50.

jess: reducing retries on LB to 1 for upstream errors. `lbctl update-retry inference-gateway --retries 1 --retry-on 5xx,connect-failure` (applied 12:18).

mike: raising envoy circuit-breaker max connections and pending requests for inference-backend cluster by +2x to reduce eject sensitivity. Applied to canary envoy instances first.

alex: monitoring metrics. 5xx rate dropped from 4.6% to 1.8% 2 minutes after rollback+retry tweak. connection resets trending down.

ops-bot: Incident status update — mitigation in progress. Customer impact: multiple customers reporting timeouts for inference API (elevated error rates); SLO alert firing.

jess: digging into host-level metrics: some backend hosts show elevated CPU and QPS and had been previously tiered with smaller instance sizes. Noticed a recent canary that changed host capacity labels in the pool.

sarah: timeline: 12:03 infra-ci weight swap -> 12:05 weight fully shifted -> 12:07 retries amplify -> 12:10 cb ejections start -> 12:13 5xx spike -> 12:16 LB rollback -> 12:18 retry limit -> 12:20 cb threshold increase -> 12:22 visible improvement.

kate: @alex are we still seeing customer-facing errors? any major customers impacted? we need to draft comms if SITREPs are needed.

alex: on-call notes: continued partial errors for a small percentage of requests; most traffic recovered. No major customer outages identified in the first-pass support triage, but subset of high-QPS customers saw elevated latency and occasional 5xx between 12:05-12:20.

mike: next steps: 1) revert canary capacity labels (infra change) 2) schedule a controlled weight rollout with slow splay and health checks 3) update LB retry policy defaults to safer values for HTTP/2 4) add metric alarms for retry amplification pattern.

jess: creating a post-incident ticket with root cause hypothesis: automated weight change + aggressive retry policy + low CB thresholds on varied host capacity => retry amplification -> host exhaustion -> 5xx cascade.

ops-bot: oncall-handoff prompted: alex -> jess at 12:45 UTC.

alex: leaving a short remediation checklist in the thread:
- revert infra-ci weight-change automation to require approval for >20% weight moves
- add lbctl pre-check to warn on large weight deltas
- set LB retry defaults to 1 for http2 and remove retry-on-connect-failure for now
- increase CB eject thresholds for short window overloads
- instrument a "retry amplification" Grafana dashboard (retry rate vs ejection rate & host CPU)

jess: adding logs & snippets to the incident ticket. sample envoy upstream log: 
```
[2026-04-15T12:14:30Z] upstream reset: "connection termination" cluster: inference-backend_pool host: 10.12.5.34
```

mike: adding a short blameless note: infra-ci weight swap was intended to shift capacity for deployment, but lacked circuit breakers on weight changes. We'll coordinate with infra team.

sarah: closing loop: 5xx back to baseline (~0.15%) by 12:32 UTC after full remediation steps. Keeping monitoring for 2 hours.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigations applied) — follow-up ticket: INF-5472 created for automation guardrails and dashboarding.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll own the follow-up and coordinate the postmortem with infra and lb teams.

jess: leaving a note here for support: if any customers still have errors, tag me and escalate.

kate: thanks team :thumbsup:
